newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off amid concern over CANTV.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off amid concern over CANTV.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed lower Friday amid concern that CANTV's share placement may be delayed, traders said.
"It's not knowing when Venezuela's Securities Commission will approve the prospectus," said one trader.
The market's 19-share index slipped 0.39 percent to finish at 5,973.49 points on trading of 16 million shares worth 2.4 billion bolivars ($5 million).
